welcome: ✡️ Shabbat Guardian Shabbat and holiday times, daily zmanim, Daf Yomi and the Omer, for your location. Choose what to view, or open your preferences to manage your language and location. Group administrators can manage each group through “My groups”.
info_intro: ℹ️ Your guide to Shabbat Guardian Your times, in your language, for your location. Choose a topic for clear instructions and useful commands. Group administrators can also find automatic closing, reminders and message design here.
info_personal_text: /preferences - language, location, Israel or diaspora calendar, and candle-lighting and havdalah methods. /lang - choose from six supported languages. Private-chat times use your preferences. Personal changes do not change group settings. /start - return to the main menu.
info_calendar_text: Your times /shabbat - upcoming Shabbat, continuous Yom Tov periods, Torah portion, Mevarchim and nearby observances in one message. /zmanim - daily times for your location; choose a date with buttons. /daf - Daf Yomi. /omer - seasonal Omer count. Consecutive holy days Every candle lighting and the final exit are shown. Holiday start/end times are shown only for Yom Tov classified by Hebcal. Hanukkah, Chol Hamoed and other observances are not themselves Yom Tov. Location and methods Personal preferences control private views; every group has separate settings. Jerusalem defaults to 40 minutes before sunset for candles and can be customized. Times use the selected IANA timezone, including daylight-saving changes. Missing times are never guessed. Share sends a result to another chat. Calendar and times: Hebcal.com. The exit policy shown in the message is your selected setting, in degrees or minutes after sunset.
info_groups_text: Connect and open the panel Add the bot as a group administrator, then send /settings there. Group administrators can also open it from My groups in private. Group command menus show only settings. What can you configure? Location and language, Shabbat and holidays, daily times, Daf Yomi, tefillin, Omer, message design and permissions. Every group has independent settings. Choose a mode Off, messages only, locking only, or messages and locking. Under Shabbat and holidays choose days, timing methods and the times-announcement schedule. Saving requires current administrator permission. Review the summary before enabling; private previews do not send to the group.
info_notifications_text: Each reminder is independent Choose daily times, Daf Yomi, tefillin or Omer in the group panel, enable it explicitly and select local times. Buttons guide you without configuration keys or tokens. Tefillin Choose weekdays, fixed times, intervals or minutes before sunset. Set quiet hours, a daily limit and deletion of the previous reminder. Shabbat, Yom Tov, Chol Hamoed and Tisha B'Av settings are respected. I put on tefillin The reminder button counts unique users; another click cancels your choice. Administrators can rename or disable it. Times announcement Under Shabbat and holidays, choose publication time and message design. Previews stay private; a group test requires confirmation.
info_messages_text: Messages and design Choose closing, opening, Shabbat/holiday times, daily times, Daf Yomi, tefillin or Omer. Edit text, photo/media and buttons independently. Natural editing Send the message as you want it to appear. The bot preserves Telegram text and formatting, including bold, links and custom emoji. Review the preview and confirm Save. Buttons Add a link, choose a style, remove buttons or restore defaults. Times and Daf Yomi messages have a default share button. Changing only buttons preserves generated content. When custom emoji are unavailable, regular emoji are used. Group test messages require explicit confirmation.
info_privacy_text: Control over settings City search and location sharing show a choice and preview; only confirmation saves changes. Personal preferences do not change groups. Current administrator rights are checked before management actions. Stored data User/group identifiers, preferences, rights and operation records needed for the service. The tefillin button records your choice for unique counting; another click cancels it. Testing and transparency Previews remain private. Group tests require explicit confirmation. Do not send passwords or tokens. /source brings together the official repository, running version, license and corresponding build source.
info_operators_text: /admin - subscribers, statistics and broadcasts. /setcommands - command menus by language and chat scope; preview before publishing. /testzmanim - check time calculations and scheduling. /closegroups and /opengroups - manual actions for authorized groups. /restart - restart gracefully. These controls are reserved for bot operators. Group administrator rights do not grant bot administration access.

info_permissions_text: Which groups are supported? Telegram allows bots to change default permissions in basic groups and supergroups. The bot must be an administrator with permission to restrict members. Default restrictions apply to ordinary members; administrators may still write. Before enabling Choose the city, timezone and Israel or diaspora calendar. Under Shabbat and holidays, choose locking only or messages and locking. Review candle lighting, opening and closing offsets, and the bot's permissions. When the group opens The bot saves permissions before closing and restores them afterwards. Consecutive Shabbat and Yom Tov days stay closed until the final configured exit. External permission changes or missing rights may require administrator review. Deleting messages Cleanup while closed requires delete-message permission. Cleanup of other bots' messages is a separate option and also depends on which updates Telegram delivers.

permission_error_conflict: Current permissions differ from the saved state. Automatic changes were stopped for administrator review.

permission_status_wait: Waiting to retry after the Telegram limit
permission_status_busy: Another operation for this group is in progress

permission_status_idle: There is no bot-owned lock to open

restart_requested: ♻️ Starting a graceful restart. The bot will return after starting again.
recovery_intro: The bot saves normal permissions before locking and restores them when opening. Review an unfinished attempt here and choose how to continue.
recovery_more: {{count}} more differences. The action covers every permission, including those not displayed here.
recovery_no_differences: No differences from the saved original permissions.
recovery_preview_adopt: Accept current permissions The group's current permissions will become its normal state. This action does not change group permissions. It closes the old lock attempt; the next lock saves the latest state.
recovery_preview_restore: Restore saved permissions The bot will request every group permission saved before the issue, undoing later changes. Restoration succeeds only after verification with Telegram.
recovery_preview_notice: Check the group name and your choice before confirming. Confirmation expires in five minutes. Permissions and state are checked again; manual recovery is unavailable during an active lock, Shabbat or festival.
recovery_result_adopted: ✅ Current permissions accepted as normal. The old attempt is closed.
recovery_result_restored: ✅ Saved permissions restored and verified. The old attempt is closed.
recovery_block_active_lock: 🔒 A safe recovery window cannot currently be verified: a lock, Shabbat or festival may be active, or calendar data may be unavailable. You can inspect and refresh; manual changes require confirmation that no protected period is active.
recovery_block_no_problem: ✅ No permission issue is awaiting recovery. The next lock will save the group's latest permissions.
recovery_block_missing_snapshot: ⚠️ No verified original snapshot can be restored. If accepting current permissions is offered, first check that they are the normal permissions you want.
recovery_block_locked_current: 🔒 The group currently appears locked. This cannot be accepted as its normal state. Review restoration or contact the bot operator.
recovery_block_unknown: ⚠️ Safe recovery cannot be verified right now. Refresh; if this continues, contact the bot operator.
recovery_result_stale: ⌛ Confirmation expired or the state changed. Review the current state and create a new confirmation.
recovery_result_forbidden: Current administrator permission for this group is required.
recovery_result_busy: ⏳ Another group operation is running. Refresh shortly.
recovery_result_conflict: ⚠️ Telegram returned an unexpected state. The original information is preserved; review the comparison before trying again.
recovery_result_error: Recovery could not be completed or verified. Saved information was not deleted. Refresh before trying again.
recovery_result_retry_wait: ⏳ Telegram requested a wait. Avoid repeated clicks; refresh later.
recovery_cancelled: Choice cancelled. No manual recovery was performed.
recovery_state_problem: ⚠️ A lock attempt is unfinished. Review the differences and choose the intended state. Each option opens a separate confirmation before execution.
diagnostics_read_only: Read only. Snapshot valid for 15 minutes; refresh for current data.
diagnostics_methods: Candle minutes / exit method and value
diagnostics_limited: Groups shown / total. Another group: /testzmanim and its ID
diagnostics_busy: Processing or recently completed. Refresh every 30 seconds; export once a minute.
diagnostics_unavailable: Diagnostics unavailable, expired, or access denied. Retry /testzmanim privately in 30 seconds.
diagnostics_export_caption: 📄 Calendar and permissions diagnostics. Read-only snapshot.
diagnostics_empty: No results match this search and filter.
diagnostics_page_prompt: Send a page number from 1 to {{pages}}. The existing panel will update.
diagnostics_search_prompt: Send a word, date or group ID to search the saved snapshot (up to 80 characters).
diagnostics_invalid_page: Invalid page number. Choose a number within the displayed range.
diagnostics_concurrent_change: Saved permissions changed during the check. Refresh before comparing.
diagnostics_invalid_search: Search is too long. Enter up to 80 characters.
recovery_block_unverified_snapshot: ⚠️ The saved permissions come from an older version and were not verified by the new reader. They may differ from the former group settings, so restoring them is disabled. Outside Shabbat, Yom Tov or an active lock: set the intended group permissions in Telegram, choose Refresh here, review them, then confirm Use current permissions. The older snapshot remains available for diagnosis.
permission_error_unverified: The snapshot from the older version needs administrator review. Open Resolve permission problem in group settings; do not restore the older state from it.
permission_error_readback: ⚠️ The permission update was sent, but its result was not verified. Permissions may already have changed. Review them in Telegram and Resolve permission problem before retrying.
